events_seen: FREE AGENT ADD (Sep 13 (yesterday)): Ryan added Dyami Brown (WR, WAS) (dropped Devontez Walker (WR, BAL)).
FREE AGENT ADD (Sep 12 (2 days ago)): Drew added Charlie Kolar (TE, LAC).
WAIVER CLAIM (Sep 09 (5 days ago)): Ryan added Jaydon Blue (RB, PHI) (dropped Dyami Brown (WR, WAS)).
WAIVER CLAIM (Sep 09 (5 days ago)): Ryan added Efton Chism (WR, NE) (dropped Sam Howell (QB, DAL)).
CUT (Sep 09 (5 days ago)): Ryan released Mitchell Trubisky (QB, TEN).
CUT (Sep 09 (5 days ago)): Ryan released Michael Carter (RB, TEN).
CUT (Sep 09 (5 days ago)): Ryan released Jonnu Smith (TE, GB).
CUT (Sep 09 (5 days ago)): Jake released Ja'Lynn Polk (WR, FA).
CUT (Sep 09 (5 days ago)): Jake released Kenny Pickett (QB, CAR).
CUT (Sep 09 (5 days ago)): Jake released Cade Stover (TE, HOU).

tweets.name: Vivienne Ashcroft
tweets.text: Tonight's desk: Ryan's revolving-door roster construction gets its proper examination, Drew's Kolar add is either stabilization or noise depending on who you ask, and we are not leaving without a definitive take on whether AEGIS at $114.98 is still a buy after a week of moves that would make any compliance officer nervous. Eight o'clock.

tweets.name: Dexter Vail
tweets.text: Everyone's focused on the Deepwater meltdown and I get it, but the quieter story is Sovereign at $63.56 with a thinning QB room in a superflex league. I pointed to that pick-hoarding discount as the core structural risk before this season started. The Levis cut was just the most visible symptom.

tweets.name: Matteo Honeydew
tweets.text: The Ryan waiver activity from five days ago — Jaydon Blue in, Efton Chism in, Trubisky and Carter and Jonnu Smith all cut — reads like a man emptying his closet and filling it with things he found on the sidewalk. Could be genius. Could be chaos. With Aegis those two things have never been easy to tell apart.

tweets.name: Vance Hollis
tweets.text: AEGIS has released Trubisky, Carter, and Jonnu Smith in the same window while cycling the same wideout through the roster twice in five days. At $114.98 the market is still pricing Ryan as an elite operator. I'm not sure that number survives a full month of this offseason roster energy.

tweets.name: Terrence E. Odom
tweets.text: Jake released Ja'Lynn Polk, Kenny Pickett, AND Cade Stover on the same day five days ago. Three assets. Gone. I will acknowledge that EchoPoint's RB room is elite, their stock is at $103.99, and sometimes you cut bait cleanly. This was clean. I will not say it was wrong. I will say it took longer than it should have.

tweets.name: Bo Ruckman
tweets.text: Ryan dropped Dyami Brown to add Jaydon Blue, then re-added Dyami Brown by dropping Dyami Brown. I read that three times and it still reads the same way. Aegis is a championship-winning organization and also apparently a revolving door for one specific Washington receiver.

tweets.name: Jay Kelpey
tweets.text: Drew adding Charlie Kolar two days ago is exactly the kind of move that gets no coverage and absolutely deserves some. EchoPoint isn't the only team with a TE problem — Atlas has been running that desk empty for months. Kolar isn't a fix but he's a placeholder that at least has a pulse. ATLAS at $53.53 is still bargain-bin territory but the pieces are being assembled, slowly.

tweets.name: Dina Ravioli
tweets.text: Ryan added Dyami Brown yesterday — the same Dyami Brown he dropped five days ago to add Jaydon Blue. That's not a coincidence, that's a revisit. I'm told Aegis is still searching for WR depth that can hold a roster spot. The churn on the back end of that 24-man is real.
